Christopher Columbus

**Definition and Scope of Nutrition Science**
Nutrition science is the field dedicated to examining how organisms utilize food to function, grow, and maintain health. It focuses on the study of nutrients, dietary habits, and food systems to understand their overall impact on human well-being.

**Health Impacts of Poor Nutrition**
Inadequate dietary practices can lead to a variety of serious health issues. Common consequences of poor nutrition include obesity, diabetes, and heart disease.

**Benefits of Good Dietary Practices**
Conversely, maintaining good dietary habits can promote longevity and significantly reduce the risk of developing chronic ailments.
